source_snapshot.title: Paid parking to be activated in Abu Dhabi's Musaffah sectors M10 and M17
source_snapshot.text: Abu Dhabi: Q Mobility, the company that manages and operates Abu Dhabi’s public parking and Darb road toll system, has announced that paid parking will be introduced in two more sectors of Musaffah from 16 November 2026. The move, covering sectors M10 and M17, will be implemented under the regulatory supervision of the Integrated Transport Centre (Abu Dhabi Mobility), an affiliate of the Department of Municipalities and Transport. It forms part of a gradual expansion of the paid parking system that began in January 2026. A total of 4,233 standard parking spaces will be activated in the fourth phase of the rollout, comprising 1,645 spaces in M10 and 2,588 in M17. Designated parking spaces for People of Determination will also be available. The expansion is intended to regulate the use of public parking and improve the management of available parking capacity, while reducing congestion and random parking, improving traffic flow and facilitating access to establishments in the area. Musaffah, one of Abu Dhabi’s major industrial and commercial areas, experiences heavy traffic throughout the day due to its range of economic and service activities and the large number of employees and visitors. The parking measures are also intended to support economic and commercial activity by creating a more organised environment and making it easier to move between different locations in the area. Standard parking spaces covered by the new phase will cost AED 2 per hour. Motorists can pay through the Darb and TAMM apps.

summary_ru: 🚗 В Абу-Даби введут платную парковку в секторах Мусаффа M10 и M17 с 16 ноября 2026 года 💰 В рамках четвёртой фазы расширения системы платной парковки в Мусаффа будет активировано 4 233 парковочных места, из них 1 645 в секторе M10 и 2 588 в M17. Стоимость стандартного парковочного места составит 2 дирхама в час. 💳 Платная парковка поможет регулировать использование общественных парковок, снизить заторы и улучшить движение транспорта в одном из крупных промышленных и коммерческих районов Абу-Даби. Оплата возможна через приложения Darb и TAMM.
